notes:
Changes since 0.1.0-beta.11.

### Added

- Click an image in a draft, email attachment, ad script, social post, article cover, or the Asset Library to open a full-window preview. The image starts fitted to the window. Click it or use the zoom control to view it at actual size.

### Fixed

- Settings tabs stay on one line. When space runs short, use the chevrons, drag the row, or use the arrow keys to reach more tabs.
- Long release notes scroll within the Updates tab while the update controls stay visible.
- Social post downloads and image exports show success or failure next to the action you used. Downloading all platforms shows progress while the export runs.
- Open drafts retry missing image references by refreshing the Asset Library, so images restored or added externally can appear without reopening the draft.

### Installation notes

- Beta.7 and later can update through Settings → Updates. Earlier betas require one manual install. Beta and stable update channels remain separate.
